correctness.rationale: The Cartan group is topologically R^5. The open 5-ball is homeomorphic to R^5, and R^5 has trivial fundamental group at infinity. Kauranen-Luisto-Tengvall Proposition 4.3 therefore applies and gives homeomorphism; degree ±1 follows for a self-homeomorphism.

evidence: The proposition holds in every n>=3 under torsion-free fundamental group at infinity.
broader_coverage.reasoning: It strictly covers the single Cartan/R^5 application.

evidence: R^5 has trivial fundamental group at infinity, hence satisfies the proposition's hypothesis.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The record follows immediately from the published theorem plus the topological identification C≅R^5.

evidence: The record's R^5 statement is the B^5≅R^5, image R^5 special case of Proposition 4.3.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Equivalent after the standard homeomorphism between the open 5-ball and R^5.

evidence: The claim is a topological corollary, not a database/table claim.

originality.rationale: The full topological statement is a direct special case of the published Proposition 4.3.
residual_risks: No originality remains beyond naming the Cartan-group specialization.

source_inspections.evidence: Proposition 4.3 states for every n>=3 that a proper branched covering from B^n with compact branch set is a homeomorphism when the image has torsion-free fundamental group at infinity.
source_inspections.material_read: Open-access full text, including Definition 4.2 and Proposition 4.3.
source_inspections.title: On proper branched coverings and a question of Vuorinen
source_inspections.trigger: Exact theorem cited by the record.

source_inspections.evidence: The exact record was the direct match.
source_inspections.title: Published Resultary SCOPE084

value.rationale: The specialization requires only the standard facts C≅R^5 and trivial fundamental group at infinity. It is a routine parameter/application corollary and does not add a new motivated boundary, structural lemma, or exact invariant.

limitations: This does not prove that an independently defined analytic quasiregular map on the Cartan group is open and discrete.
Nonproper maps and noncompact branch sets are outside the statement.
